item.name: SwordBlessed Race
item.coreBonus: +20% Sword damage with high HP and damage
item.description: The single strongest race for sword-based builds. SwordBlessed grants a massive +20% Sword Damage Multiplier on top of enormous HP and damage buffs, giving sword mains an unrivalled edge in both PvP and boss farming.

item.name: Galevorn Race
item.coreBonus: +20% Melee damage, +80% HP, +75% damage, lifesteal, and damage reduction
item.description: Top-tier Mythic race for melee builds. Galevorn brings +20% Melee DMG Multi, 80% Max HP, 75% DMG, 3% Lifesteal, and 10% DMG Reduction — making it the best all-round offensive race in the game.

item.name: Sunborn Race
item.coreBonus: +20% Sword damage, +80% HP, +70% damage, lifesteal, and damage reduction
item.description: A radiant Mythic race combining sword power, raw damage, and survival. Sunborn gets +80% Max HP, +70% DMG, +20% Sword DMG Multi, +3% Lifesteal, and 10% DMG Reduction — rivaling SwordBlessed for sword builds.

item.name: Servant Race
item.coreBonus: +17% Melee damage, +75% HP, +67% damage, and high lifesteal
item.description: A fearsome Mythic race with +67% DMG, +75% HP, +17% Melee DMG Multi, 10% DMG Reduction, and 4% Lifesteal. The highest lifesteal percentage of all Mythic races makes Servant exceptional for sustained combat.

item.name: Slime Race
item.coreBonus: +17% Sword damage, +70% HP, +65% damage, lifesteal, and damage reduction
item.description: A Mythic race themed around slime regeneration. Provides +70% Max HP, +65% DMG, +17% Sword DMG Multi, +3% Lifesteal, and +10% DMG Reduction. Slightly below the top trio but still solidly S+.

item.name: Warlord Race
item.coreBonus: +22% Melee damage, +85% HP, and +80% damage
item.description: The highest-offense Mythic race in Sailor Piece, added in the Massive Update 7.0. Warlord provides +85% Max HP, +80% DMG, and +22% Melee DMG Multiplier — the highest Melee DMG Multi of any race — plus 2% Lifesteal and 10% DMG Reduction. Best in slot for pure melee damage builds.

item.name: Luckborn Race
item.coreBonus: +35% luck with sword and melee support
item.description: A new Mythic race added in the Ice Update (April 8, 2026). Luckborn provides the highest Luck bonus of any race (+35%), making it exceptional for farming rare drops from the new Frost Boss. Also boosts Sword Damage and Melee Damage, making it versatile for combat builds.

item.name: Leviathan Race
item.coreBonus: +17% Sword damage, +60% damage, +65% HP, and high lifesteal
item.description: A sea-monster Mythic race with +17% Sword DMG Multi, +60% DMG, +65% Max HP, and 5% Lifesteal — the highest lifesteal in the game. Great for players who prefer survivability.

item.name: Kitsune Race
item.coreBonus: +25% luck with melee and sword damage support
item.description: A luck-focused Mythic race with +10% Melee DMG Multi, +10% Sword DMG Multi, +50% DMG, +60% Max HP, and +25% Luck Multi. Best race for drop-farming runs.

item.name: Oni Race
item.coreBonus: +20% Melee damage, +65% HP, +55% damage, and damage reduction
item.description: A demon Mythic race with +65% Max HP, +55% DMG, +20% Melee DMG Multi, and +10% DMG Reduction. Oni excels as a tanky melee option and is frequently recommended in S-tier by top players for melee-only builds.

item.name: Hollow Race
item.coreBonus: Dedicated weapon bonus with solid combat stats
item.description: An A-tier race with a dedicated weapon bonus passive. Hollow synergizes well with specific endgame weapons and provides solid combat bonuses for weapon-focused builds.

item.name: Shadowborn Race
item.coreBonus: Shadow-themed weapon bonus and dark combat passives
item.description: An A-tier shadow-themed race with a signature weapon bonus and powerful dark-energy passives. Popular for players who use shadow or dark-type swords.

item.name: Shinigami Race
item.coreBonus: Sword lifesteal and a V3 sword burst window
item.description: Shinigami is an A-tier sword race in Sailor Piece with lifesteal and a 15-second burst at V3 (+15% Sword DMG Multi). Get it via Race Reroll — roughly a 2–4% chance. Full V1/V2/V3 abilities, best build pairings, and reroll tips inside.

item.name: Player Race
item.coreBonus: Dedicated weapon bonus with flexible combat stats
item.description: A unique A-tier race with its own dedicated weapon bonus. The 'Player' race is themed around player-state empowerment and grants versatile combat boosts.

item.name: Vessel Race
item.coreBonus: Weapon bonus with extra survivability
item.description: An A-tier race acting as a conduit for power. Vessel has a weapon bonus passive and solid survivability, making it a reliable mid-to-late game race option.

item.name: Fishman Race
item.coreBonus: +15% EXP gain and +15% money gain
item.description: A Fishman race that rewards grinding with passive EXP and money bonuses. With +15% EXP Gain and +15% Money Gain it's the best race for efficiently leveling and earning Cash.

item.name: Mink Race
item.coreBonus: Speed-focused passives and Electro-style movement value
item.description: A speed-focused race with powerful movement passives and Electro attacks. Mink is the go-to race for mobility-first playstyles and evasion builds.

item.name: Skypea Race
item.coreBonus: Moderate combat stats with sky-themed passives
item.description: A sky-island race with abilities themed around heavenly power. Skypea provides moderate combat bonuses and unique sky-based passives.

item.name: Vampire Race
item.coreBonus: +30% HP, +25% damage, and +5% lifesteal
item.description: Vampire offers +30% HP, +25% damage, and +5% lifesteal. The built-in lifesteal makes Vampire a strong mid-tier option for sustained combat, allowing health recovery while attacking.

item.name: Limitless Race
item.coreBonus: +25% Gojo sword damage, +30% damage, and +40% HP
item.description: Limitless grants +25% Gojo (Sword) DMG, +30% DMG, and +40% Max HP. A weapon-locked Legendary race that shines specifically with Gojo sword builds but is less versatile than other options.

item.name: Human Race
item.coreBonus: No innate race bonus
item.description: The default starting race for all players. Human has no innate attribute bonuses but is the baseline from which every player begins their journey.

item.name: Orc Race
item.coreBonus: Small all-round combat boosts
item.description: A straightforward race with modest combat bonuses. Orc is a beginner-friendly option that provides small all-round stat increases without complex mechanics.

item.name: Demon Race
item.coreBonus: +35% HP, +30% damage, and faster sprint speed
item.description: Demon provides +35% HP, +30% damage, and faster sprint speed. An accessible Epic-rarity race with strong fundamental stat boosts, making it a solid choice before obtaining a Mythic race.
